tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All General Conditions of Eligibility as per tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer shall have minimum one year past experience in operation of granite quarry either of his own or through contract in any one of the previous years between 2021-22 to 2025-26 for having provided the machineries or for having done excavation contract for granite. In case of own quarry, the latest valid lease document of the quarry to be submitted. In case of contract, the contract agreement / work order and work completion certificate shall be submitted.

The tenderer shall possess Ownership of machinery vehicle or leasing of machinery Vehicle from the machinery owners as per the minimum requirement stipulated in scope of work. Minimum Requirement of Equipment Vehicles Equipment vehicle shall not be older than 10 years as on last date for submission of tender

Achieved minimum annual turnover of Rs.4,36,39,200/- (Rupees Four Crore Thirty-six Lakh Thirty-nine Thousand Two Hundred Only) each in any Two years during the past five financial years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26

The tenderer shall be granite factory owners/ traders/exporters.In case of factory owners they should have processed min 500 m3 of granite blocks in any one year during past 5 years 2021-22to 2025-26 In case of trader they should have purchased min 500 m3 of granite blocks in any 1 year during past 5 years 2021-22 to 2025-26
